origin.description: Keep cached values in a remote bucket.

arguments.name: algo
arguments.text: Hash used as the object name when memoise uses this cache.

origin.details: Stores a serialized value in the bucket and reads it back. Dropping a key deletes the bucket, because both arguments of delete_bucket are the bucket name.
origin.value: A cache with set, get, has_key, drop_key, reset, keys, and digest.

json_num <- function(x) {
  parts <- sprintf("%.17g", as.numeric(x))
  if (length(parts) == 1) return(parts[[1]])
  paste0("[", paste(parts, collapse = ","), "]")
}
one <- function() {
  name <- paste0("bkt", sprintf("%08d", sample.int(1e8, 1)))
  s3 <- cache_s3(name)
  s3$set("abc", 4)
  got <- s3$get("abc")
  has <- s3$has_key("abc")
  nkeys <- length(s3$keys())
  s3$drop_key("abc")
  has2 <- s3$has_key("abc")
  c(got, as.integer(has), nkeys, as.integer(has2))
}
cat(paste(one(), collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")

translation.example:
import json
import os
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

ready = Path(tempfile.mktemp(prefix="s3ready"))
subprocess.Popen(
    [sys.executable, "-m", "memoise._s3mock", str(ready)],
    stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
    stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
)
for _ in range(100):
    if ready.exists() and ready.stat().st_size:
        break
    time.sleep(0.05)
info = json.loads(ready.read_text())
os.environ["AWS_S3_ENDPOINT"] = f"127.0.0.1:{info['port']}"
os.environ["SSL_CERT_FILE"] = info["cert"]
os.environ["CURL_CA_BUNDLE"] = info["cert"]

from memoise import cache_s3

def one():
    name = f"bkt{os.urandom(4).hex()}"
    store = cache_s3(name)
    store.set("abc", 4)
    got = store.get("abc")
    has = store.has_key("abc")
    nkeys = len(store.keys())
    store.drop_key("abc")
    has2 = store.has_key("abc")
    return [got, int(has), nkeys, int(has2)]

print(*one())
